claims.claim: TASK-124 changes no public product_intelligence API, no TASK-123 public dataclass fields, no builder/renderer signatures, and no canonical RAG schema/version.
A canonically valid context that fit before TASK-124 renders byte-for-byte the same deterministic compact JSON after TASK-124 under the same values and byte budget.

Supplemental packing no longer catches a general CanonicalRagContextError and silently treats every such failure as omission; byte-budget rejection is decided independently from render/integrity failure without exception-message parsing.

A retrieval hit whose matching witness is valid but whose otherwise eligible supplemental evidence contains a naive observed_at fails construction with CanonicalRagContextError rather than returning truncated=true or incrementing omitted_evidence_blocks.

A non-renderable supplemental block still fails closed when its serialized content would also be too large for the current remaining budget, proving validity is not bypassed merely because the block could have been omitted for size.

Timezone-aware observed_at values continue to canonicalize to UTC and value-equal instants represented with different offsets continue to produce identical rendered JSON where all other values are equal.
Valid oversized supplemental evidence remains omitted whole in exact existing canonical order, with no partial truncation and exact truncated / omitted_evidence_blocks metadata.
Mandatory-context overflow behavior remains fail-closed, all retrieval witnesses remain mandatory, and TASK-122 delegation still occurs exactly once with unchanged retrieval semantics.

Exact hit/profile/witness/source-evidence identity, supplemental evidence identity, conflict plurality, evidence whitelist, citation addressing, and evidence_policy behavior remain unchanged from TASK-123.

Focused regressions cover valid budget omission, naive-datetime supplemental failure, invalid-and-oversized supplemental failure, mandatory overflow, UTC offset-equivalent determinism, exact renderer bytes for valid contexts, exactly-once retrieval, and preservation of no-model/no-I/O behavior; documentation records TASK-124 as packing integrity hardening only.
